text: Bubbles rise in the peat. {lead} follows them down and brings up, to its evident pride, a roll of notes.
The bowl sails over the bend like it knew the road. {lead} trots after it, and finds Sloes in the grass.
A dead tree, waiting for an excuse. {lead} supplies one. In the roots, undisturbed for years: some loose change and a gratitude card.
A gap in the wall, where the stones have gone for a walk. {lead} fits them back one by one, like a very slow jigsaw. Tucked in the wall behind: some loose change and a gratitude card.
